Nanopb message types, tags, and defaults for transaction test fixtures.

# Purpose
This nanopb header defines the Protocol Buffers message types used to describe Solana transaction test data and execution results. It declares structures for transaction headers, compiled instructions, address table lookups, sanitized transactions, execution context, resulting account state, rent and fee details, and full transaction fixtures. The file also provides field tags, nanopb field lists, default initializers, and message descriptors so code can encode and decode these messages in a fixed binary format. It serves as the schema bridge between test data files and the transaction execution code in the codebase.
